log.notes_to_self: Day 1: killed 7: national plus both regional:North, clips, and foreign criminals. All quick entries in AFTERNOON. Continue using afternoon only: this preserves night workers + students + home (55% of population); morning deaths unnecessarily eliminate students. Avoid docket: sector evidence is stronger (20% rather than 25%). Unknown inaccessible pair is fixed, drawn from regional/sector/age/forum/foreign. A source with inaccessible records cannot yield any successful trace, including cross-reported victims. Two accessible primary sources remain safe; three eventually reduce the pool below 1,000 even with the 55% routine baseline. Target sustained 9/day from national+North+clips+foreign+forum, excluding docket; this is permanently safe if sector is accessible (60% prior), but risky otherwise. Suggested ramp to delay dangerous exposure without losing the day-5 quadrupler: daily counts 7,7,8,9,9. Thus day2 repeat today's three nonnational sources; day3 add just ONE forum criminal; from day4 potentially both forum criminals. First five total 40, day4 total31 gives double and day5 quadruple; thereafter 9/day sustains quadruple. Reassess after day3 press conference before committing to expansion. With afternoon-only routine and clean independent evidence, pool is 55,000 before source constraints, 13,750 after one 25% source, 3,438 after two, 859 after three (caught); cross-reported OR clauses may leave intermediate/larger pools. Press sizes are rounded to 1 significant figure, and lack of shrinkage is evidence, not proof, that records are inaccessible. Capturing late halves all accumulated points, so weigh further exploration against banked score. Day1 count=7; no timed entries used.

Day1 killed 7 (national + both North, clips, foreign), all quick afternoon. Day2 selected the same source mix, 7 kills, all quick afternoon; cumulative 14 if accepted. No forum/docket kills yet. Keep deaths in afternoon: >2 afternoon deaths eliminate day workers but preserve night workers, students, home = 55,000 baseline. Morning would unnecessarily eliminate students. Timed entries offer no present advantage. L's fixed inaccessible pair is among regional/sector/age/forum/foreign; traces touching either inaccessible kind fail entirely. Successful traces of cross-reported cases give OR constraints, not necessarily a single source. A national victim is uninformative. Clean accessible 25% source constraints yield pools 13,750 after one, 3,438 after two, 859 after three (caught). Thus our current three-source mix is permanently safe unless all three are accessible (initially 10% chance). Adding forum makes four nonnational sources; permanently safe if sector/docket is accessible (initially 60%), but potentially fatal otherwise. Avoid docket, whose 20% constraint is stronger. Survival and rounded pool feedback update these probabilities; no shrinkage does not prove inaccessibility. First conference reflecting play should arrive after day3. Tentative threshold ramp: counts 7,7,8,9,9 gives 31 cumulative on day4 (double) and 40 on day5 (quadruple). Day3 could add ONE forum victim to the existing 7; reassess before doing so and especially before day4 expansion. Do not blindly commit to four sources irrespective of feedback. Thereafter 8/day suffices to sustain the 40-in-five quadrupler, while 9/day earns more but exposes extra deaths for tracing. Seven/day eventually yields only the double multiplier (35-in-five). Finishing uncaught has no separate value, but capture halves all accumulated points and ends earning. Daily traces select 3 victims randomly; reducing uncertain-source kills lowers their sampling probability. We are not told which victims were traced. Current only conference: day0 pool100000.

Days 1 and 2: 7 kills each, national + both North, clips and foreign, all quick afternoon. Day 3: selected those same 7 plus both forum cases, total 9, all quick afternoon. Expected cumulative raw kills/points after day 3: 23, since no multiplier yet. No docket kills ever. Only conference available before this decision was day0:100000.
Keep all deaths in afternoon. More than 2 afternoon deaths exclude day workers but preserve night workers, students and home people: routine baseline 55000. Morning deaths could unnecessarily exclude students. Timed entries currently offer no advantage.
L has a fixed inaccessible pair among regional, sector, age, forum, foreign. A trace fails entirely if ANY reporting outlet is inaccessible. Successful nonnational traces impose OR constraints over all reporting places, not necessarily a pure source constraint. National reporting is uninformative. We cannot see tracing outcomes; conferences are rounded, so lack of shrinkage does not prove inaccessibility.
Our four used nonnational kinds are regional/North, age/clips, foreign and forum, all 25% audiences. Avoid sector/docket. If docket is accessible, both inaccessible kinds are among our four: only TWO of our used kinds can yield successful traces. Then afternoon-only play restricted to these four is permanently safe, with at least 55000*(.25^2)=3438 suspects. Under a uniform prior this is 60% of games. If docket is inaccessible, three of our four kinds are accessible; eventually clean traces can reduce the pool to 859 and cause capture. This is a deliberate early risk for the much more valuable sustained quadrupler, not a guarantee of safety. Three-source-only play was safer but usually capped at 7/day and the double multiplier.
Plan to reassess at the first conference after day3. Nine/day using national+North+clips+foreign+forum gives rolling totals 32 on day4 and 41 on day5, hence double on day4 and quadruple from day5. Thereafter 8/day sustains 40 in five, while 9/day earns more. Prefer 9 if continuing this source mix. Do not introduce docket casually: using all five kinds necessarily exposes three accessible dimensions. Pool near 14000 suggests one strong audience constraint; near 3000 can mean two. An uncaught pool rounded to 1000 or 2000 implies more than two used dimensions are informative and warrants major caution. Finishing uncaught has no separate bonus, but early capture halves points and ends earning.

Day4 chose 9 kills: national + both North, clips, forum and foreign; no docket, all quick afternoon. If uncaught, cumulative raw kills=32 and points=41 (7,7,9,18). Another 9 on day5 gives 41 deaths over days1–5, activating quadruple scoring: 36 points that day, cumulative77. Continue 9/day by default to sustain quadruple.
Conference after day3: pool3000. This is consistent with two clean 25%-audience constraints: 100000*.55*.25^2=3437.5. It does NOT identify which sources are accessible, nor prove safety. Successful traces with hidden additional reports impose OR constraints; failed traces provide nothing. Avoid overinterpreting rounded counts.
We use four nonnational kinds: regional/North, age/clips, forum, foreign. Never used sector/docket. If docket is accessible, exactly two of our four kinds are accessible, so this source set remains safe indefinitely: at least3438 suspects with afternoon routine. If docket is inaccessible, three used kinds are accessible and further traces can cause capture. The conference and survival update these possibilities but do not settle them. Continuing nine/day accepts this risk for sustained36/day instead of retreating to seven/day and usually14/day. Introducing docket would jeopardize the currently safe possibilities and is not worthwhile this early.
